notes: Canvas: layer effects (the fx button under the layer list). An outline, a shadow, a glow and a bevel that follow whatever is drawn on the layer, and can be changed or cleared any time
An outline is as wide round a thin pen line as round a filled shape, with round corners: for stickers, lettering and line art
Canvas: Retouch (J). Clone copies from a place you set (Alt+click); Heal does the same but keeps the light of where it lands; Lighten and Darken work the middle tones
Clone and Heal can copy from everything shown onto an empty layer, so the photo underneath is never touched
